Serving Andover, KS

Ranch Experiences near Andover.

Diamond Springs Ranch is about 35 minutes from Andover via US-54 and K-15 — the closest working ranch experience for east Wichita metro families and corporate teams.

Book a Trail Ride Get Directions
Scroll

Andover is about 30 miles east of us — a 35-minute drive via US-54 and K-15. Andover has grown fast as a community, but there’s no working ranch in city limits. Families from Auburn Hills, Rolling Meadows, Tallgrass Estates, and the 21st Street corridor come to us for birthday parties, church outings, and anniversary experiences they can’t find any closer.

Corporate teams from Andover’s business corridor use the ranch for quarterly retreats. The private event rental includes the full ranch property — 30 minutes from east Wichita without highway traffic. Andover guests in our reviews consistently say the drive is worth every minute.

Why Do Andover Families Visit Diamond Springs Ranch?

Andover has great amenities. A working ranch with horseback rides, Highland cattle, and a treehouse overnight isn’t among them. We’re the closest place in the region for that combination — 4.9 stars across 281+ verified reviews, with Andover guests returning regularly over the years.

What Guests Are Saying

Real reviews. Real experiences.

★★★★★
“If we could give more stars we would. We stayed in the Wagon just for an evening and did horse back riding to celebrate our anniversary. The property is gorgeous, and staff were all so super nice. A storm did come throughout the night, however the wagon was so comfortable that it wasn’t awful/uncomfortable. We definitely plan on going back in the future!”
Jaicia Mills
★★★★★
“Our stay at the ranch was nothing short of amazing. We got to go on a peaceful, beautiful horseback ride, the whole experience was incredibly calming. Dinner was fantastic-perfectly cooked steak with vegetables and a potato, followed by little cheesecake bites that were the perfect dessert. They even made a fire for us afterward, which made the evening feel warm and cozy. We spent the night in one of their wagon rooms, and it was wonderfully comfortable, unique, and relaxing. They also worked really well with our schedule for booking everything, which made everything even easier and more enjoyable. Every single person we interacted with was welcoming, friendly, and extremely attentive. You can truly tell they care about making your experience special. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a peaceful getaway with great people, great food, and unforgettable experiences.”
Daniel Jaques
★★★★★
“I can't say enough amazing things about this ranch!! From the beginning to the end hands down the best horseback riding I've experienced. It was my boyfriends 1st time on a horse and they were so good at getting him familiar with the horse and riding. The young gal Sophia was our guide and she did such an amazing job and took great pics!! The place was STUNNING!! The horses were so gentle so if you are hesitant, DON'T be! My girl Eden was such such a good girl!! I wish there were 10 stars because this place and their people deserve more than 5!! Can't wait to go back!!!”
Shannon Scalisi
